plugins.name: creed
plugins.description: Injects the compressed operating core every session and prompt; gates unverified completion claims.

plugins.name: ask-all
plugins.description: Ask the user many questions at once: an in-terminal form tool (mcp__ask-all__ask) with per-option trade-offs and conditional follow-ups, plus ask-all-form, the same spec as a browser form.

plugins.name: trust-check
plugins.description: Audits a company website from outside, the way a careful buyer would, and builds one HTML report: trust signals, reputation, code safety, email reachability, legal gaps, market fit, persona verdicts and issue counts by domain.
